authorship: Original unbranded geometry. Manufacturer photographs and specifications were consulted as references; no downloaded photography, logos, meshes, certification marks or source CAD is embedded.
dimensionPolicy: All catalog dimensions are original design targets in millimetres, including projecting controls, fittings and fixed hoses. They are not installation or service clearance requirements. Manufacturer dimensions below are separate comparison evidence.
duplicateAudit: Searched current src expansion JSON files for each appliance family. Existing fans, kitchen appliances, fireplace heaters, network rack and outdoor condenser do not duplicate these 14 utility/safety families.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official page specifies cylindrical tank, two elements, top water connections and brass drain; dimension section lists height 46.5 inches and diameter 19 inches.
records.construction: Rolled base/top seams, separate element access covers, top capped couplings, service label, relief fitting and low brass drain. Includes short capped visual piping only.

records.reference: Legrand radiant 885TRLACC8 outlet and RWP26LACC6 faceplate
records.verifiedEvidence: Official outlet dimensions 1.29 x 1.0 x 4.2 inches are the receptacle, not its plate. Separate official faceplate lists 3.15 inch width, 0.25 inch depth and 4.5 inch height.
records.construction: Original slightly oversized bevelled plate with recessed duplex insert, physically cut blade/ground openings, dark inner contacts and one central fixing.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official family page and product illustration establish pressed steel front panels and the top-covered convector form. No single model's dimension is claimed.
records.construction: 22 pressed front channels, folded rear convectors, individual top grille bars, end covers, wall stand-offs, capped unions and a ridged thermostat cap.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official product page identifies a portable inverter appliance with top discharge and an exhaust hose system. The authored model is an original single-hose study, not a faithful branded Duo mechanism.
records.construction: Caster cabinet, open top louvers, front/rear filter slats, grips, drain cap and open corrugated exhaust hose. Combined footprint deliberately grows beyond the original 430 mm proposal to contain the fixed hose. Separate flat adaptor has a genuine collar opening.
records.placementLimit: Static hose remains inside the appliance bounds. Adaptor is independently placeable; there is no live connection, automatic window fit, hose routing or installation-clearance validation.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official page lists dimensions 27.4 x 27.4 x 52 cm and shows lower cylindrical intake, solid shoulder and top control/exhaust layout.
records.construction: Actual open grille cage around a recessed filter cylinder, separate bands and ribs, radial exhaust vanes, inset display and static status ring.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official page describes the Cube tank arrangement. URL capacity wording conflicts with the model name; no capacity or manufacturer dimension has been inferred.
records.construction: Raised housing over a genuinely hollow bucket, separate grilles, caster wheels, bucket grips, drain port, water-level window and a top carrying handle.

records.reference: Schneider Electric Square D Homeline 30-space cover
records.verifiedEvidence: Official cover specification lists 888.49 mm high and 392.18 mm wide, baked-enamel gray finish and combination flush/surface cover.
records.construction: Shallow enclosure with trim, separate closed inset cover, hinge barrels, latch and fixings. Internal deadfront and toggles remain editable in Blender; door animation is not implemented.

records.reference: First Alert SC5 smoke/CO alarm family
records.verifiedEvidence: Official family page supplies low-profile alarm construction references. This circular model is an original interpretation, not an exact SC5 branded silhouette.
records.construction: Top twist mounting base, lower broad test/hush face, real gaps between radial intake separators, status lens and original TEST label.
records.placementLimit: Ceiling fixture with its controls authored facing downward; use ceiling elevation behavior and no wall rotation. No detection simulation.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official specifications list 24.5 x 19.2 x 34 cm; top-fill reservoir, directional outlet and display inform the original model.
records.construction: Boolean-hollow translucent tank, visible interior water block, seal, removable top lid, swivel outlet, separate lower base and original static 45% graphic.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official retailer product page identifies the steel return grille; nominal 12-inch duct size is not treated as outer-frame size.
records.construction: Four folded frame members, separate pitched louvers, dark plenum behind actual gaps and corner screw recess detail. No wall opening is cut.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official pages identify wide paddle, narrow slider and subtle locator illumination. Chosen plate envelope is original and deliberately not attributed to a manufacturer's specification.
records.construction: Tilted paddle within a recessed insert, separate slider channel and thumb tab, warm faceplate and static indicator.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official detailed specifications distinguish thermostat 103.89 x 103.89 x 25.9 mm from larger optional trim plate. Original target is slightly larger.
records.construction: Soft-square metal case, dark inset display, rear mounting plate, lower sensor slot and original static 21 C room graphic.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official page and imagery show portable metal cylinder, gauge, pin, lever assembly and supplied bracket. The original model adds a compact flexible hose configuration rather than claiming exact HOME1 reproduction.
records.construction: Spun shoulder/base, valve, carrying and squeeze handles, retaining pin and pull ring, seal tag, gauge needle/ticks, hose/nozzle and bracket. Label is original and contains no certification mark.

records.verifiedEvidence: Official front, left-profile and right-profile gallery plus technical-data links establish the long wall-mounted cabinet and bottom outlet. Source image endpoints were opened separately after transformed image URLs failed.
records.construction: Back rail, separate front fascia and seams, recessed lower outlet, 18 separate vanes, fixed swung louver, individual top inlet slats and status panel. No cooling or outdoor-unit connection is simulated.
